column1: # legacy_shows.tsv - shows attended before the history TSVs begin in 2021 (issue #468).
# One row per act per show, lifted once from tools/archive/setlist_attendances_20260626.tsv
# (the setlist.fm "I was there" export); a shared bill is one row per act with the same
# Show Date and Venue. Domain content, not map configuration: the map builder is its
# first consumer (seen counts, bill edges, settlements for acts the index does not know),
# and it is available to any future one. It never feeds artists.tsv, data/history/ or the
# recommendation index, and nothing globs it in with the history. An act the index does
# not resolve can be aliased in data/recommend_aliases.tsv.
# Not in-page-editable, so this comment block is safe (same convention as related_acts.tsv).
